sentences.text:
Applicant :- Ram Bhawan
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru.Prin. Secy.

Counsel for Applicant :- Anil Kumar Yadav
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1. Heard Shri Anil Kumar Yadav, learned counsel for the applicant, learned Aga and perused the
record.

2.  The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.0064 of 2024, under Section 376, 452 IPC,
P.S. Malipur, District Ambedkar Nagar.
3.

In terms of the FIR registered on 27.03.2024 it was alleged that on 24.03.2024 at about 3 PM when the victim was alone at home, the applicant allegedly entered into the home and committed wrong on her.

Subsequently, the statement of the victim was recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C.,
wherein she reiterated the said version.
She also stated that she was pregnant and was carrying a fetus of nine months.
The medical which was done on 28.03.2024, did not support any allegation of any force being used.
The tentative age of the victim is around 28 years.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
1 4. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.
5. Considering the fact that the victim was nine months pregnant and the medical does not corroborate the allegation coupled with the fact that the FIR has been lodged after three days, the applicant who is in custody since 01.04.2024 and has no criminal history, is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Ram Bhawan be released on bail in aforesaid FIR number on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 15.7.2024 nishant  Ram Bhawan vs State Of U.P. Thru.Prin. Secy. /Addl. ...
